en-US.title: Girapphe
en-US.subtitle: Learn what you can explain
en-US.description:
Turn concepts and your deliberately selected notes into a private, reviewable knowledge map. Browse connected ideas, practice with clear self-ratings, review what remains unclear, and keep progress synced across web and mobile.

Girapphe keeps you in control: conversation material becomes a pending draft only when you choose to submit it, and you review or edit it before approval. Private notes remain owner-scoped and never mutate the public knowledge graph.

Core learning stays available for free. An optional monthly or annual subscription removes sponsored practice cards. Purchases are managed by the App Store and can be restored in the app.
